lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Tobin sent you? I have charcoal. Dry, counted, and quite ordinary. He can mend my cart axle when the forge is hot.
lines.direction: Low, easy, confidential dockside voice; a smile kept just out of sight.

options.label: Fuel now, an axle repair in return. Agreed.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Take the marked bundle. Tell Tobin I remember my debts, and his. No shards in this bargain.
lines.direction: Low, easy, confidential dockside voice; a smile kept just out of sight.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: The bundle went to the forge. I will bring the cart when the road lets me.
lines.direction: Low, easy, confidential dockside voice; a smile kept just out of sight.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Fair enough. Mind the boards. They are older than my promises.
lines.direction: Low, easy, confidential dockside voice; a smile kept just out of sight.
